title: Clay Giles in the brass bands, and Robichaux's bass drum
summary: Clay played every brass band in town; John Robichaux was the first to play bass drum in the street; the uncles played only brass bands.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Well, I was asking a little bit more about your Uncle Clay then. Do you remember which brass bands he played with? You mentioned your father came down and played with Onward and different bands.

Well, he played with the Salsa and occasionally with Moe's, every brass band in existence because he was a good drummer and anytime they had a chance to use him they would always try to get Clay Gile. Because Old Man Robichaud was the first man I understand that I heard that played a bass drum in New Orleans in the street. Joe Robichaud, he was a violin band.
Not a John Robichaud. John Robichaud. The old man, the violin. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Left-handed violin. Yeah, that's right. Yeah, that's right.
That's right. You know what town he came from? Is... John Robichaud? Yes.
If he...
I can't recall, but it's some country town, but I...
Somebody once said he came from Thibodeau. I wondered if you knew that he'd come from up there. Well, if he did, I don't remember. You didn't remember hearing about him at play.
But I know he come from some country. Yeah. Because when my uncle come to town, Clay Gile, and he played so much bass drum, he quit playing bass drum.
Robichaud did. That's right. Yeah.
That's right.
I suppose in those days like today they'd play with all the different bands. Oh yeah. That's right, that's right.

At that time, if you was good and you was idle and they needed a drummer, they would hire you, or any instrument. If it was a trumpet, clarinet, because musicians were scarce at that time, they wasn't plentiful like they are today.
You know if he played in any dance orchestras too, did you ever hear him play at dances?
Who is that?
Your uncle Clay.
No, he never did play nothing but brass bands. Just brass bands. My daddy played in the...
And of your other uncles, when they moved down, did they play in dance bands too?
No, they only played in brass bands.
And all your uncles moved down here, Albert?
That's right.
They all moved down here.
Yeah, that's right.
Oscar and Olivia.
Claire, that's right.
Olivia, yeah.
And they played in brass bands too?
Yeah, they all played in brass bands.
Did any of them play in dance bands besides your...
Daddy, no. None of them played in...
You would rate your uncle, and after your father you would say your uncle Clay was probably the...
The best.
And I thought he was the best known, I just wondered.
Yeah, that's right.
Because you should know, I mean... Yeah, that's right. They were all related to you, so you wouldn't have any bias. That's right. If you'd say so, he must be right.
Yeah.
